raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Business Analyst / Senior Consultant | Ernst & Young (EY) Hyderabad · Sep 2024 – Present Client: HSBC | Project: Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) – AML/KYC Platform Enhancement
Elicited, documented and validated business requirements from senior compliance stakeholders at HSBC for a Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) programme spanning a team of 28 investigators.
Facilitated requirement workshops and JAD sessions on Dynamic Risk Assessment (DRA) and holistic network analysis features, producing BRDs, process flow diagrams and RACI matrices.
Supported business capability assessment and value-stream mapping as part of the DRA and network analysis initiative, helping define current- and target-state elements of the FCC operating model.
Created detailed User Stories with Acceptance Criteria and maintained the Product Backlog in JIRA, breaking down large compliance epics into sprint-ready stories with the Product Owner.
Managed stakeholder expectations across business, technology and compliance verticals; maintained stakeholder registers and delivered fortnightly status reports to senior management.
Defined acceptance criteria and coordinated end-to-end UAT for SAR/GFCC escalation workflows, authoring test scenarios and tracking defects through to sign-off.
Translated AML regulatory mandates into functional specifications for CDD/EDD screening and negative-news modules, ensuring full traceability from requirement to delivery.
Handled Change Requests (CRs) via impact analysis and requirements traceability matrices throughout the SDLC.

Identified process improvement opportunities that reduced alert disposition time by 15%, directly contributing to SLA adherence and quality benchmark targets.
Prepared production and quality MIS reports for senior management; conducted structured training sessions to upskill new team members on compliance processes.
Supported Business Capability Assessment by identifying process gaps, dependencies and improvement opportunities across Financial Crime Compliance workflows.
Supported Target Operating Model (TOM) analysis by documenting current-state and target-state processes for AML/KYC platforms.
● Participated in Value Stream Mapping workshops to identify operational bottlenecks and improvement opportunities
across investigation workflows.
● Partnered with Compliance, Technology and Business stakeholders to align business processes with strategic operating
model objectives.
Conducted Business Process Re-engineering initiatives to streamline Financial Crime Compliance operations and reduce processing turnaround time.
Prepared Current-State and Future-State process models using BPMN, UML and Swimlane diagrams. ● Collaborated with Product Owners during backlog prioritization and release planning to ensure alignment with business objectives.
Supported Regulatory Change initiatives through impact assessments and requirements traceability.
Business Analyst / Business Process Lead | Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Hyderabad · Mar 2023 – Aug 2024 
Business Analyst / Credit Officer | HSBC Hyderabad · Sep 2016 – Mar 2023 Project: Credit Card Application Automation & KYC/CDD Platform
Led end-to-end BA activities for the Credit Card Application Automation Project, gathering requirements from 6 business units and producing comprehensive BRDs and FRDs coordinated with Technology and Senior Management.
Defined business rules for automated credit-worthiness validation, integrating CDD/EDD and World-Check screening into a mobile application workflow — reducing card issuance time from 15–20 days to 10 days.
Created UML Use Case and Process Flow Diagrams, and facilitated stakeholder interviews and process workshops to identify pain points and produce swimlane diagrams and process improvement recommendations.
Documented functional and non-functional requirements for RFI management, PEP screening and UAR modules using internal tools (RDC World-Check).
Acted as liaison between Compliance, IT and Operations; maintained requirements traceability matrices and managed scope change through a formal change-request process.
Performed end-to-end verification, validation and quality-control checks on completed cases, and escalated suspicious cases to compliance review teams.
Conducted Value Stream Analysis for AML Transaction Monitoring processes to identify optimization opportunities.
Performed Process Mapping and Gap Analysis using BPMN and UML. ● Worked closely with Product Owners during Sprint Planning and Backlog Refinement sessions. ● Supported enterprise process standardization across multiple compliance workstreams. ● Coordinated with Architecture and Development teams to ensure solution alignment with business objectives. ● Developed training material and delivered knowledge-transfer sessions to 20+ team members on new processes and regulatory procedures.
Business Analyst (Associate) / Customer Service Executive | CMC TCS Hyderabad · Mar 2013 – Jun 2016
Analysed customer service workflows and identified process gaps, producing requirement documents that underpinned CRM system enhancements and service delivery improvements.
Supported UAT and user training for new service delivery tools, contributing to a measurable improvement in first-call resolution rates.
Organised and delivered product-knowledge and client-interaction sessions, reducing new-hire onboarding time and improving service delivery metrics.
KEY PROJECT HIGHLIGHT
Credit Card Application Automation – HSBC
BA lead for end-to-end digitisation of the credit card application journey via a mobile app, cutting card issuance time by ~50% and significantly improving customer experience.
Collaborated with Technology and Senior Management to draft requirements, produce BRD/FRD and define the mobile- app roadmap including in-app application-status tracking.

Integrated automated credit-worthiness validation and CDD/EDD/World-Check checks directly into the app workflow, replacing manual branch-based processes.
Post-launch: reduction in branch complaints and customer queries; new approach became the standard for digital onboarding across the region.
raw_sections.projects:
Projects: Actimize Transaction Monitoring Rule Optimisation; Payments & Corporate Banking Compliance Initiative
Gathered and prioritised requirements from compliance and operations stakeholders for Actimize-based Transaction Monitoring enhancements, documenting AS-IS and TO-BE process flows using BPMN/UML.
Collaborated with technology teams to translate AML business rules into functional specifications for rule-tuning and false-positive reduction initiatives.
Supported requirements analysis on a separate Payments and Corporate Banking compliance initiative, gathering process and control requirements alongside the core Transaction Monitoring workstream.
Wrote User Stories and Acceptance Criteria, maintained the Product Backlog in JIRA and facilitated sprint planning, daily stand-ups and retrospectives within an Agile delivery framework.
Created detailed process documentation, standard operating procedures and user manuals, enabling seamless knowledge transfer and audit readiness across a 15-member analyst team.
Conducted quality reviews and implemented corrective measures, improving team accuracy rates by 18% quarter-over- quarter.
Ensured compliance with AML regulatory standards and maintained audit readiness through robust process documentation and change-log management.
Led end-to-end Customer Journey Analysis for Credit Card onboarding and servicing initiatives.
Conducted AS-IS and TO-BE Process Assessments to improve customer onboarding efficiency. ● Facilitated cross-functional workshops involving Business, Compliance, Operations and Technology teams. ● Identified process bottlenecks and recommended automation opportunities to improve Straight Through Processing (STP).
Created functional workflows and business process models for Credit Card lifecycle enhancements. ● Performed Business Impact Analysis for regulatory and operational change requests.
